blocks.text: 突发：Revolut 把约 2,000 名工程师转到自托管的 GLM 上写代码，并把 Claude Code 和 Codex 列入了例外清单。 据该公司负责 AI 运营的 David Abitbol 介绍：56 块 Nvidia B200，混合成本为每百万 token 30 美分，大约是他们付给 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的十分之一。工程交付周期缩短了 70%。 关键在于：这些收益是在 token 不再被限量供应之后才出现的。工程师们不再把 AI 省着用在难题上，而是把它用在所有事情上。 前沿模型成了例外，开放权重成了默认选项。对每一家准备 IPO 的实验室来说，这都是个定价问题。 h/t @OliverMolander 如果账单降了 90%，你会让团队弃用前沿 API 吗？

blocks.text: BREAKING: Revolut moved ~2,000 engineers onto self-hosted GLM for coding and pushed Claude Code and Codex to the exception list. Per David Abitbol, who leads AI ops there: 56 Nvidia B200s, a blended 30 cents per million tokens, roughly a tenth of what they paid Anthropic and OpenAI. Engineering lead time improved 70%. Here's the part that matters: the gains showed up when tokens stopped being rationed. Engineers quit saving AI for the hard tickets and pointed it at everything. Frontier models become the exception, open weights become the default. That's a pricing problem for every lab heading to IPO. h/t @OliverMolander Would you move your team off frontier APIs if the bill dropped 90%?
